title: Daniel Dobrygowski (WEF · author, Technology Governance) swaps signed books with Eric at the Summit — 'Good governance is having a moment!'
summary: The World Economic Forum's governance lead, who spoke later the same day on how technology choices shape governance for decades, photographs the two of them trading signed copies and reads the keynote as a case that corporate governance has to change so companies can serve the public good again.
blockquote: Eric’s keynote made a compelling case that corporate governance has to change so companies can serve the public good again. Later that same day, I spoke about how we decide on new technologies, and why those choices will shape governance for decades.
attribution_title: Head of Governance and Trust, World Economic Forum · author, Technology Governance
